C3.registered_measured_by: restart phase rows vs live phase rows, per item, named not counted
C3.registered_trigger: arm A loses any taught item across a restart
C3.what_the_rows_are: tell0.26 and tell0.38, both in the object shape, at depth 3. Both were answered correctly before the restart and refused after it -- not answered wrongly. That distinction matters to the reading: this is loss of availability across a restart, which is exactly what C3 was written to catch, and it is arm A, the arm H1 claims holds its taught set.

confabulation_on_unanswerable_asks_grows.definition: rows whose ask has no taught answer (the manifest's distractor items) that nonetheless carry an answer. Measured because C1's registered basis (src == electric_absence) is not evaluable for arm A at any tier -- see D-MPE8-07 -- so the behaviour has to be observed directly.
confabulation_on_unanswerable_asks_grows.reading: 9.3% at tier 40, 20.7% at tier 120, 26.8% at tier 300. The invented share in particular goes 0 -> 13 -> 91. This is the direction H1 predicted for arm B and H2 predicted arm A would NOT show.

cross_tier_comparability.tier_120_to_300: permitted: both strict constraint-(b). The depth-3 refusal rate rises 12.7 -> 20.6 pp and depth-3 correct falls 83.4 -> 75.0.
cross_tier_comparability.tier_40_to_either: not permitted as a curve (regime break, 8 asks) -- see the registration

headline: abort condition C3 fired at tier 300: two taught items were correct in the live phase at depth 3 and refused after a restart. C3's registered action is abort. The same measurement returns zero rows at tier 40 and zero at tier 120.

wall_clock.confounded_by: the machine's own load history is in the log, and this run held the machine alone. What is NOT controlled is the bench's per-depth work: 1,046 probes is 2.5% more than projected, so a 10.88% saving cannot be attributed to the harness alone.
wall_clock.reading: the projection overshot by 10.88%: 53.65 measured against 60.2 registered, with the probe count 2.5% ABOVE its projection (1,046 against 1,020). Cost does not track probe count linearly at this tier; two contacts, -2.6% then -10.88%, is a trend in the projection being conservative, not a proof. The registered projection is left exactly where it is.

what_this_does_not_do: it does not execute the abort and it does not waive it. C3 says abort; executing or overriding a pre-registered stopping rule is not the agent's call, and the difference between the two is visible in the record rather than assumed.
